sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A rhizomatous aquatic perennial with a circumboreal range. Emergent stems usually rise 5–40 cm above the water; the species grows in still or slow water over mud.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: The leaves occur in whorls of 6–12; those on submerged stems are longer and softer. Tiny flowers without petals sit in the leaf axils; the small dry fruit contains one seed.

sections.title: Family and edibility
sections.text: The species is now placed in Plantaginaceae. No reliable food use is documented.
